_note: Brightwater items: weaponsmith and armourer stock (Common/Uncommon, required levels 14-28), wands, potions, elixirs, bandages, food and drink for levels 12-30 with their use abilities, quest items and quest rewards. Stats follow Docs/Expansion.md §8 (0.55 x ilvl x Qa x slot; WeaponDps x .64 Common / .72 Uncommon; ArmorValue).

items.name: Hollowell Sabre
items.description: Dunstan's work: a sabre that sings when you draw it, mostly off-key.

items.name: Chapel Censer-Mace
items.description: Weighted like a censer, blessed like a lamp, swung like a mace.

items.name: Eel-Skinner
items.description: Narrow, wicked and very good at its original job.

items.name: Lamplighter's Pole
items.description: Long enough to reach the highest wick, sturdy enough for anything else.

items.name: Bargebreaker
items.description: Named after the incident. Dunstan does not talk about the incident.

items.name: Ford-Warden's Spear
items.description: The Heronguard carried spears like this to fish ducklings out of the shallows.

items.name: Kingfisher Longbow
items.description: Strung with heron-gut by somebody who apologised to the heron first.

items.name: Floodgate Shield
items.description: Riveted oak faced with river-steel. Things bounce off it, including advice.

Reedwood Wand
items.description: Cut from the river reeds. Hums faintly near water.

items.name: Kingfisher Wand
items.description: Tipped with a blue feather that is definitely not from a real kingfisher. Pell swears.

items.name: Lamplit Wand
items.description: A lantern-glass bead at the tip glows when you aim.

items.name: Lamplit Wand of the Ford
items.description: A lantern-glass bead at the tip glows when you aim.

items.name: Lamplit Wand of the High Water
items.description: A lantern-glass bead at the tip glows when you aim.

items.name: Greater Healing Potion
items.description: Ottoline's own. Tastes of cherries, copper and the fear of failure.

items.name: Riverlight Healing Potion
items.description: Brewed by moonlight on the river steps. It glows, faintly, like a promise.

items.name: Mana Potion
items.description: Bright blue, and it fizzes in a way that suggests opinions.

items.name: Greater Mana Potion
items.description: Ottoline labels these DO NOT SHAKE. She shakes them constantly.

items.name: Rejuvenation Potion
items.description: Half red, half blue, and mixed this time, thanks to a very patient spoon.

items.name: Elixir of Fortitude
items.description: Thick as porridge. Twice as good for you, half as pleasant.

items.name: Elixir of Defense
items.description: Leaves a gravelly feeling in the throat that is, Ottoline insists, the point.

items.name: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
items.description: Not made from ogres. Ottoline would like that on the record.

items.name: Elixir of Agility
items.description: Your feet start tapping before the cork is out.

items.name: Elixir of Greater Intellect
items.description: Distilled from strong tea and stronger opinions.

items.name: Ember-Ward Draught
items.description: Smells of wet slate. Recommended by Ottoline for anyone walking north.

items.name: Fen-Ward Tonic
items.description: Bitter as marsh-mint. Keeps the fen's little bites from biting quite so hard.

items.name: Frostward Tonic
items.description: Warm all the way down, and then some.

items.name: Silk Bandage
items.description: River silk, cut in strips by the chapel's knitting circle.

items.name: Heavy Silk Bandage
items.description: Doubled and stitched. It will hold a knight together, briefly.

items.name: Mageweave Bandage
items.description: Faintly warm, and it smells of somebody else's spell.

items.name: Riverside Fishcakes
items.description: Marigold's fishcakes: crisp outside, soft inside, and they never taste of yesterday.

items.name: Lantern & Heron Pie
items.description: Contains no heron. Marigold is tired of being asked.

items.name: Lantern Dumplings
items.description: Steamed in little paper lanterns. You eat the dumpling, not the lantern.

items.name: Elderflower Cordial
items.description: Sweet, cold and faintly fizzy, like a summer afternoon in a bottle.

items.name: Skyreach Spring Water
items.description: Carried down from the peaks in barrels. Marigold charges for the carrying.

items.name: Moonberry Juice
items.description: Silver-blue and tart enough to wake the dead. Please do not test that.

items.name: Parcel of Lamp Wicks
items.description: Addressed in careful capitals: MOTHER WREN, CHAPEL OF SMALL LIGHTS. PLEASE DO NOT DROP IN RIVER (AGAIN).

items.name: Crate of Clock Springs
items.description: It ticks when you shake it. It should not tick. Deliver to Magister Vell, the clock tower.

items.name: Sealed Letter for the Watch
items.description: Sealed with the dockmaster's wax: a fish wearing a crown. For Captain Rowan's eyes only.

items.name: Bucket of Minnows
items.description: Silver, wriggling and irresistible to any heron with a pulse.

items.name: Admiral Puddles (in a basket)
items.description: A small, damp, deeply offended heron. He has eaten your sandwich.

items.name: Sealed Jar of Lantern Oil
items.description: Stamped with a Duskmane paw-print. Lantern oil from Amberfield, hidden under a layer of herring.

items.name: Memorial Lantern
items.description: A small brass lantern with a heron etched on the glass. One for each of the Eleven who could not carry their own.

items.name: Dockmaster's Oilskin
items.description: Smells of tar and good decisions. Mostly tar.

items.name: Hobb's Lucky Rope Belt
items.description: Tied with a bargeman's knot that nobody has ever untied, including Hobb.

items.name: Tide-Clerk's Gloves
items.description: Ink-stained at the fingertips, as all good gloves are.

items.name: The Admiral's Feather
items.description: Given with enormous reluctance by the Admiral himself.

items.name: Puddle-Jumper Boots
items.description: Waterproof, mostly. Tamsin tested them in the fountain.

items.name: Reedwoven Bracers
items.description: Plaited from river reeds by small, determined hands.

items.name: Watch-Issue Halberd
items.description: Polished for parades, sharpened for everything else.

items.name: Lantern-Oil Ward
items.description: A recovered jar of lantern oil, re-blessed by Corwin and set in a brass cage. It glows.

items.name: Riverwatch Hauberk
items.description: River-blue surcoat over good mail. The Watch has spare ones now.

items.name: Shield of the Eleven
items.description: Eleven heron feathers are painted round its rim. Nobody painted the other twenty-nine; they are carved.

items.name: Aubric's Practice Blade
items.description: Lord-Commander Aubric's old practice sword. Sir Bertram says he was never very good with it.

items.name: Mantle of the Twenty-Nine
items.description: River-blue wool with twenty-nine tiny herons embroidered at the hem.

items.name: Fen-Scout's Waders
items.description: Tall, oiled and smelling faintly of eel.

items.name: Rowan's Spare Spyglass
items.description: Brass, dented, and pointed at the horizon more often than at anything near.

items.name: Marsh-Walker Breeches
items.description: Waxed leather, stitched for wading. The knees are reinforced for kneeling in mud.

items.name: Watch-Captain's Greatcoat
items.description: Heavy river-blue wool over leather, with brass heron buttons.

items.name: High Road Gauntlets
items.description: Fur-lined for the passes. Rowan wore a pair like them, twelve years ago.

items.name: Skyreach Lookout's Hood
items.description: Grey wool with a long scarf-tail to wrap against the wind off the peaks.

items.name: Tamsin's Lucky Button
items.description: A brass button on a loop of string. Tamsin says it is lucky because she found it, which is lucky.

items.name: Pot of Minnows
items.description: Bait, mostly. Herons consider it a delicacy, and Silas considers herons a menace.

items.name: Smoked River Eel
items.description: Glossy, smoky and alarmingly long.
